content.text: Agreed. CronJob plus queue decouples schedule from execution. Tradeoff: at-least-once delivery, so the worker must be idempotent. Pin the CronJob to the spot node pool, add a PodDisruptionBudget, and set activeDeadlineSeconds so a wedged worker cannot hold the queue; expose queue depth as a Prometheus gauge so the HPA scales on backlog instead of CPU, with a stabilization window so it does not flap.
